name: Estelle Ceulemans - § 13 - Am 5
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: C. whereas work, despite not being the sole dimension of individuals’ lives, is an important part of it, whereas exposure to psychosocial risk factors at work has serious negative effects on workers’ mental and physical health, including work-related stress, burnout, anxiety disorders, depression, cardiovascular diseases, neurological and musculoskeletal disorders and long-term work incapacity and constitutes a motive to increased demand for mental healthcare and medication use;
